headline: Brazil Electoral Court Opens Probe Into Lula-Alckmin Ticket
summary: The electoral court's general corregidor accepted a complaint from the Novo party to open an action against President Lula and Vice President Alckmin for alleged economic power abuse.
why: Political and legal challenges involving ruling administrations create policy uncertainty and influence domestic asset valuations.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Political legal proceedings can introduce short-term regulatory and governance uncertainty.
